= Cloud September 10, 2026

[NOTE]
====
Kobiton now uses date-based release versioning. Instead of version numbers such as 4.26S or 4.19.3, releases are identified by the build date in YYYYMM.DD format. For example, 202609.10 represents a build created on September 10, 2026.

Cloud release notes are typically published weekly and summarize changes since the previous publication. +
Version information for individual software components is available in the Component versions section.
====

== Target release TBD

// Source: KOB-54737 from PR #585
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/585

== Kobiton MCP server

- Fixed an issue where the `getCredential` MCP tool returned an authorization error for MCP servers configured with API key authentication. The tool now returns your username, API key, and portal URL under both API key and OAuth authentication.

// Source: KOB-54809 from PR #584
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/584

== Kobiton MCP server

- Fixed the `listTestRuns` tool rejecting requests that sorted test runs by creation date. The tool now declares the sort keys it accepts, `CREATED_AT` and `NAME`, and requests that use the earlier lowercase spelling succeed.

// Source: KOB-54806 from PR #583
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/583

== AI and MCP

- New: the Kobiton `automate` plugin adds a `listTeams` tool that returns the teams you belong to. Organization members can now look up a team id and complete a test management list call that previously failed with `Team id is required`.
- The `teamId` descriptions on the test case, test suite, and test run tools now state the team scoping rules that the API enforces. Organization admins who omit `teamId` receive organization-level items only. Organization members pass a `teamId`. No list call returns items from more than one team.

// Source: KOB-54604 from PR #581
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/581

== API keys

- API keys on *Settings > API Keys* are now hidden by default. Select the eye icon next to a key to show its value, and select the icon again to hide it. Each key is controlled independently, and every key returns to the hidden state when you leave the page and open it again.
- The *Copy* action copies the real key value whether the key is hidden or shown.
- The API Keys page now includes a *Created* column showing the date each key was generated.

== Device management

- Fixed the Device Management page failing to open. On a fresh page load it redirected to a "Can't find what you're looking for" error, and when opened from another Settings page it reported "You currently have no hosting machine" even though host machines were connected. This occurred only when a single host machine ran two or more devices that share a device name and report no operating system. Device Management now lists every connected host machine and its devices.

== Session Explorer

- Fixed the Overview tab showing `undefined` in the *Operating System* field for a device that reports no operating system. The field now shows only the OS version.

// Source: KOB-54740 from PR #572
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/572

- Fixed the *CLI for Mac*, *CLI for Windows*, and *CLI for Linux* links under *Downloads* in Kobiton Portal, which pointed to an outdated package location. Each link now resolves to the most recently published CLI build for its platform.

// Source: KOB-54741 from PR #571
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/571

=== Portal

- Fixed an issue where opening Kobiton Portal at its root URL hid features included in your subscription until you refreshed the page. The *virtual devices* tab was missing from the device list, and Kobiton CLI packages were missing from Downloads in the left navigation. Opening a Portal page by its direct URL was not affected.
